hooks.name: Lint and test after code edits
hooks.description: After the agent edits a file, reminds it to run pyflakes and the related tests before finishing, as the project steering requires.

action.prompt: You just edited a file in the IDPS project. Before you finish this task: if any Python file under netsentinel/, tests/ or tools/ changed, run `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pyflakes netsentinel tests tools idps.py` and the tests for the modules you changed (or the full `.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` when several modules changed), and fix any failure. Never touch the user's real ~/.netsentinel data.
